data.text:
C.M.Kuruvila vs The Food Safety Officer on 23 May, 2024 
Author: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Bench: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Crl.MC No.716/2021 1/1
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas
 Thursday, the 23rd day of May 2024 / 2nd Jyaishta, 1946
 Crl.M.Appl.No.1/2021 In Crl.Mc No. 716 Of 2021
Cc 65/2020 Court Of Chief Judicial Magistrate ,Thrissur
 Applicants/Petitioners:
 C.M.Kuruvila, Aged 67 Years ,S/O.C.K.Markose, Chittenmariyil,
 Adimally, Idukki-685561, (Nominee Of Eastern Condiments Pvt. Ltd.,
 Adimaly). And Another
 Respondent/Respondent:
 The Food Safety Officer, Thrissur Circle, Thrissur-695601.  AND  2 OTHERS  Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein  the High Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings in  CC.No.65/2020 pending on the files of the court of the Chief  Judicial Magistrate, Thrissur, pending disposal of the above  Criminal Miscellaneous Case. 
 This Application again coming on for orders upon perusing the  application and this court's order dated 23/11/2023 in Crl.MA.1/2021  and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.P.VIJAYA BHANU (SR.), 
 SRI.M.REVIKRISHNAN, SRI.AJEESH K.SASI, SRI.P.M.RAFIQ, SRI.THOMAS  J.ANAKKALLUNKAL, SRI.V.C.SARATH, SRI.VIPIN NARAYAN, SMT.POOJA  PANKAJ, SRUTHY N. BHAT, Advocates for the petitioners, and  the PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the 1st & 2nd respondents, and of  MR.SANTHAN V NAIR, Standing counsel for the 3rd respondent, the  court passed the following:
 ORDER Interim order shall stand extended by two months.
Sd/- BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE 23-05-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar C.M.Kuruvila vs The Food Safety Officer on 23 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100530660/
1
